name: Andrew Riley
purpose: Represent Andrew Riley as an individual: credibility, character, and the through-line that connects every business entity. This profile is for speaking, writing, and media where the person—not a company—is the primary brand.

voice.summary: Sound like someone who has done the work and can explain it plainly. Prefer concrete examples, short sentences, and a calm confidence. Let expertise show through structure and accuracy, not jargon.
voice.theyAllSoundLike: Every Andrew Riley touchpoint—personal or business—should feel like the same person showed up: clear, fair-minded, and allergic to empty marketing noise. Business entities may dial formality or playfulness up or down, but never swap integrity of voice.
do: Lead with the point, then support it
Use “we” for shared work, “I” for personal point of view
dont: Mimic trends that clash with stated values

audiences.label: Peers and collaborators
audiences.needs: Technical or strategic depth without posturing.

audiences.label: Broader public
audiences.needs: Accessible language and a human reason to care.
